domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n > 1
k is an integer with 0 <= k <= n - 1
t is real and satisfies k <= n*t < k + 1
f(n)(t) is defined for the given real t
g(n)(k) is defined for the given integer k (consistent with g mapping natural-number indices to reals)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n > 1, for every integer k with 0 <= k <= n - 1, and for every real t with k <= n*t < k + 1, it holds that f(n)(t) <= g(n)(k).
quantifier_order: for all t (real, k <= n*t < k + 1)

variables.name: n
variables.role: outer universally quantified parameter indexing the families f and g

variables.domain: real numbers (with constraint k <= n*t < k + 1)
variables.name: t

variables.domain: maps n in natural numbers to a function from real numbers to real numbers
variables.name: f
variables.role: fixed function family used via f(n)(t)

variables.domain: maps n in natural numbers to a function from natural numbers to real numbers
variables.name: g
variables.role: fixed function family used via g(n)(k)

statement_nl: Let f : ℤ → ℝ → ℝ and g : ℤ → ℤ → ℝ be fixed families of real-valued functions. For every integer n with n > 1, every integer k with 0 ≤ k ≤ n - 1, and every real number t with k ≤ n*t < k + 1, one has f(n)(t) ≤ g(n)(k).
